messages.author: 49de5c221fe2204c
messages.subject: Categorical variables with tidyLPA
parts:
Hello Team,

 

Is LPA able to model latent profiles with categorical variables as predictors (e.g. Latent “class” analysis)? If not, is there future plans to implement?

Do you know of any other implementations that can handle categorical variables for LPA input?

Josh pointed me in the direction of the the poLCA package but I’d like to know your suggestions a well!

 

Essentially, I have a mix of continuous and categorical inputs that I would like to build latent profiles on!

 

 

Best,

Tim

messages.author: 3cfaef29dbc536f8
messages.subject: Re: Categorical variables with tidyLPA
parts:
Tim, I'm so sorry for my delay; dissertation got a hang of me but it's done now! :)

I'd like to consider including this functionality in tidyLPA, but unfortunately it would (probably) be by providing an interface to the poLCA package. Because of the different response type - categorical, and if I understand correctly, with a log-link function, it will take a good bit of work. I can't guarantee we'll get to this unless others can take it up. Perhaps for the functions that use MPlus it may be a bit easier, but that requires MPlus, which is always a bit disappointing (to me).

So, sorry to (possibly) disappoint. Have you found any other solutions in the mean time?
Josh
